title: Xiaomi Mimo 2.6 live post-training dashboard
summary: Xiaomi's Mimo 2.6 introduces a live post-training dashboard for monitoring reinforcement learning model performance in real-time, part of their AI/robotics platform that gained significant attention on Hacker News with 474 points.
problem_solved: Provides real-time visibility into post-training model behavior and performance metrics during reinforcement learning processes.
why_valuable: Enables researchers and engineers to quickly identify issues, validate training results, and iterate on AI models more efficiently with live feedback.
